response.explanation: The kwarg is forwarded fine (paginate takes **paginator_kwargs and OptimizedCursorPaginator.__init__ accepts enable_advanced_features). But OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key (paginator.py:838-840) calls math.floor/ceil directly on getattr(item, "datetime"), a datetime object, whereas DateTimePaginator converts it to a timestamp first. Any non-empty page raises TypeError when the cursor is built. value_from_cursor also returns the raw numeric cursor value instead of converting it to a datetime, so cursor-based filtering on the datetime column is wrong. In addition, the enable_advanced_features path slices the queryset with a user-supplied negative cursor offset, which Django rejects (AssertionError, 500), and the code comment about accessing data beyond normal bounds is misleading.
